parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container with the state. It shares the open state, the reference to the trigger, and the open, close, and toggle functions with the trigger and the content.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:open`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state at the start, for when you give no `open`.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the open state. The component stops to write back to
`open`, and it reports only through `onOpenChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the
parent does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:open` is the usual
case and it needs the write-back.

To refuse one change, use `details.cancel()`. That function works in the two modes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The reference to the trigger element. Set it in your own code, or let Popover.Trigger set it.

props.name: children
props.description: The children: the Trigger and the Content.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The role="dialog" panel that floats. It goes in a portal and takes its position against the trigger. Use it in Popover.Root, or alone with `open`, `triggerRef`, and `onOpenChange`.

props.name: offset
props.description: The distance from the anchor element, on the main axis.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position against the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Moves the panel to the opposite side when the space is not sufficient.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: The element that gives the limits of the position.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the popover.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description:
Makes the popover non-modal. The user can then operate the page, the focus does not stay in
the panel, and the page scrolls.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Closes the popover when the user clicks outside it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Closes the popover when the user pushes the `Escape` key.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Closes the popover when the focus goes out of it. The default is true for a non-modal popover.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element, or the selector of the element, that gets the focus first in the modal mode.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state, when you use the part alone.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The reference to the trigger element, when you use the part alone.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes, when you use the part alone.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-placement
dataAttributes.description: The resolved side of the trigger the panel is on ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left").

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the popover is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that registers itself as the trigger of the popover. A click opens and closes the popover. It has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the button.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

parts.name: Overlay
parts.description: An optional backdrop behind the popover. Put it beside Popover.Content, in Popover.Root. It has its own enter and exit, thus it fades with the panel.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the overlay.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the popover is open, "closed" during exit.
